page.layout: One page of text in a three-column table, with the title above it. Column 1 holds the names, column 2 the figures (two forms each), column 3 the powers. The page number is at the top, and the catchword "Numerant" is at the bottom right.
page.notes: The figure column shows Coptic letter forms in two shapes each (a larger display form and a smaller cursive form). I could not reliably read the individual glyphs, so they are marked illegible rather than guessed. The names and powers are transcribed as printed. The long s in "Poteftas" and "Ebsi" is written as a plain s. The catchword "Numerant" is at the bottom right, outside the table.
